# PRO X Wireless Gaming Headset 046D:0ABA, long-only collection FF43:0202,
# device index 0xFF, headset switched on. Its USB dongle has just been plugged
# in, and another HID++ client (software id 0xF) talks to it at the same time.
#
# Shape from an owner capture 2026-11-24 (dongle replugged with the headset on):
# the dongle answers our ping at once but never our 0x0005 lookup; meanwhile
# the other client's ping and getFeature replies (`11 FF 00 1F …`,
# `11 FF 00 0F …`) and a 0x1F20 battery broadcast arrive. Without a retry the
# group stayed unregistered for good. The discovery that follows the retry is
# synthetic, shaped like 0aba-headset-arrival.txt; the battery reading is
# synthetic too (the dongle reports the placeholder unit id FFFFFFFF).
#
# Format: `out <short|long> <hex>` is a frame BatterySight writes, `in` one it
# reads, `@t+<ms>` lets time pass and ticks the hub. Each `in` advances the
# clock by 1 ms. The `out` lines after an input are the writes that input causes.

# Group arrival at t = 0: ping index 0xFF; the dongle answers (protocol 4.2).
out long 11 FF 00 1B 00 00 5A
in  long 11 FF 00 1B 04 02 5A
# Root getFeature 0x0005, sent at t = 1: never answered.
out long 11 FF 00 0B 00 05 00
# The other client's ping replies and getFeature reply: not ours, no write.
in  long 11 FF 00 1F 04 02 00
in  long 11 FF 00 1F 04 02 D9
in  long 11 FF 00 0F 00
# t = 4 001: the lookup times out; discovery ended without registering.
@t+3997
# A 0x1F20 broadcast from the still unregistered headset: no write.
in  long 11 FF 06 00 0E B2 01
# t = 6 001, 2 s after the failure: discovery starts over with a ping.
@t+1999
out long 11 FF 00 1B 00 00 5A
in  long 11 FF 00 1B 04 02 5A
# Root getFeature: 0x0005 -> index 3, 0x0003 -> index 2, 0x1004, 0x1000 and
# 0x1001 absent, 0x1F20 -> index 6.
out long 11 FF 00 0B 00 05 00
in  long 11 FF 00 0B 03
out long 11 FF 00 0B 00 03 00
in  long 11 FF 00 0B 02
out long 11 FF 00 0B 10 04 00
in  long 11 FF 00 0B 00
out long 11 FF 00 0B 10 00 00
in  long 11 FF 00 0B 00
out long 11 FF 00 0B 10 01 00
in  long 11 FF 00 0B 00
out long 11 FF 00 0B 1F 20 00
in  long 11 FF 00 0B 06
# 0x0005 fn 0: name length 29; fn 1 at offsets 0 and 16; fn 2: type 8 (headset).
out long 11 FF 03 0B 00 00 00
in  long 11 FF 03 0B 1D
out long 11 FF 03 1B 00 00 00
in  long 11 FF 03 1B 50 52 4F 20 58 20 57 69 72 65 6C 65 73 73 20 47
out long 11 FF 03 1B 10 00 00
in  long 11 FF 03 1B 61 6D 69 6E 67 20 48 65 61 64 73 65 74
out long 11 FF 03 2B 00 00 00
in  long 11 FF 03 2B 08
# 0x0003 fn 0: placeholder unit id FFFFFFFF -> key logi:0ABA:255.
out long 11 FF 02 0B 00 00 00
in  long 11 FF 02 0B 01 FF FF FF FF
# 0x1F20 fn 0: 0x0EB2 = 3762 mV, discharging -> registered online.
out long 11 FF 06 0B 00 00 00
in  long 11 FF 06 0B 0E B2 01
